card.name: Qualifier words before a claim or plan
card.fires_on: Qualifying words that come right before the main statement, such as 'experience' in 'in my experience', 'shown' or 'demonstrated' after 'has been', and '-specific' after 'patient'. It fires in drug-label text and in casual web text.

modes.label: Has been shown/demonstrated
modes.description: Verb after 'has been' that introduces a reported finding.
modes.example: Hemodialysis has been<< shown>> to remove cycloserine from the bloodstream

modes.label: Patient-specific plan
modes.description: The '-specific' part of 'patient-specific' in taper instructions.
modes.example: or reduce the dosage (a patient<<-specific>> plan should be used to taper the dose

modes.label: Personal opinion hedge
modes.description: Words that mark a personal view, such as 'experience' or 'personally'.
modes.example: In my<< experience>> the bee post is not as popular with
